Mastermind of JPSC Exam Irregularities Arrested; Multiple Exams Passed

Abhay Tiwari, identified as the mastermind behind irregularities in the Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC) exams, has been arrested and sent to jail. The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) is investigating his record, which reportedly includes passing 12 examinations, including for positions like Sub-Inspector, Navy, BARC, and teacher, over 13 years. The JPSC and Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) exams are facing allegations of widespread corruption and paper leaks. Protesting students are demanding a CBI inquiry into all disputed JPSC and JSSC recruitments from 2019 to 2026. Some aspirants allege that financial influence plays a role in selections.
